decision.reason: [ev-46ef7856a4e3] is just the v3.0.0 changelog heading (dated 2024-04-29) with an "All Commits" link to the v3.0.0-beta1...v3.0.0 compare view. It doesn't describe any specific change. It names no subject, gives no before/after or change type, and says nothing about who is exposed or what happens. It only points to a compare range that bundles many commits, so we need the actual changelog entries or migration-guide text for each change before an assertion can be written.
